title: In JetBrains Toolbox App before 3.9 insufficient warning in the login dialog allowed connecting to a malicious server…
description: JetBrains Toolbox App versions before 3.9 have a vulnerability where the login dialog provides insufficient warning, potentially allowing users to connect to a malicious server. This issue does not impact confidentiality or availability but may allow limited integrity impact. The vulnerability has a low severity score of 3.1 and requires user interaction with high attack complexity.
